# §5 Commerce Analytics — Highlight Candidates

1. **eCat is the primary transaction system** — eCat captured 67.7% of all-channel GMV ($11.5M of $17.0M) and 52.7% of order volume in the trailing 12 months, firmly positioning the platform as the dominant ordering channel. [→ §commerce]
2. **Quote workflow carries a 2.1× AOV premium** — 253 quote orders averaged $6,539 vs. $3,069 overall, contributing 14.4% of eCat GMV despite only 6.7% of order volume in the trailing 12 months. [→ §commerce]
3. **eCat GMV share has softened from mid-2025 highs** — monthly eCat share of all-channel GMV averaged above 75% from May–August 2025 but has moderated to the 60–65% range in Q1 2026, suggesting a growing proportion of transactions are completed outside the platform. [→ §commerce]
4. **Buyer base is well diversified** — top 5 eCat buyers account for only 11.1% of total platform GMV in the trailing 12 months, with no single buyer exceeding 5%. [→ §commerce]

## Priority Action Candidate
- **MEDIUM**: Investigate the declining eCat capture share (from 75%+ to 60–65% of all-channel GMV) to determine whether it reflects seasonal variation, new account types ordering off-platform, or rep workflow changes — closing the gap could recover an estimated $2.0M+ in platform-processed GMV annually [HYPOTHETICAL]. [→ §commerce]
